stories.title: Binance now lets AI agents trade, but keeping them in check is largely up to users
stories.simple_summary: Binance (a cryptocurrency exchange) now allows AI robots to trade money automatically using AI tools like ChatGPT. But the company says users have to be responsible for keeping these robots under control.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and cryptocurrency traders — nothing you need to act on unless you're already involved in crypto trading.

stories.title: Stripe didn’t really buy OpenRouter because of the ‘singularity’
stories.simple_summary: Stripe (a payment company) bought OpenRouter (a startup that helps different AI programs work together). Stripe says the reason is about the future, but they're really buying it to improve their own services.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: OpenAI seeks to one-up Anthropic with new customer privacy protections
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI and a rival company called Anthropic are competing to offer the best privacy protections to big business customers — meaning your company's information stays private when you use their AI.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use AI services for your business, this is good news because companies are fighting to protect your data better.

stories.title: Cognition CEO denies report that SpaceX tried to acquire the startup
stories.simple_summary: SpaceX apparently tried to buy Cognition, an AI company that writes computer code, but Cognition's leader says this didn't happen. SpaceX has already bought another coding AI company called Cursor.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: AI was supposed to win people over by now — it hasn’t
stories.simple_summary: Even though AI is everywhere now, many regular people are becoming more suspicious and worried about it instead of excited. Tech companies thought everyone would love AI by now, but they were wrong.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows people are right to be cautious and ask questions about AI — you don't need to blindly adopt it just because companies push it.

stories.title: Google packs Search and Gemini with new AI study tools
stories.simple_summary: Google is adding new AI tools to its search engine and Gemini chatbot to help students study better. These tools help with learning and competing with OpenAI's services.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have a student in your family, this gives them free AI tools to help with homework and studying.

stories.title: Google Gemini is getting a dedicated student hub
stories.simple_summary: Google Gemini now has a special section just for students that helps them organize research, make study cards, take practice tests, and track exam dates.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have a student in your family or run an education business, this is a free study tool worth knowing about.

stories.title: Researchers say OpenAI revoked their access to limited cyber program
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI stopped letting security researchers use a special version of its AI to find and report bugs. These researchers were supposed to help find problems so companies could fix them.
stories.why_it_matters: This might slow down finding security problems in AI, which affects anyone using AI tools online — though the impact is mostly on tech companies.

stories.title: Meet the startup helping Wall Street put a price on AI compute
stories.simple_summary: A startup is helping Wall Street figure out fair prices for AI computing power (think of it like pricing electricity for AI servers). Right now there's no standard way to price it.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and big tech companies — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: OpenAI hit the brakes. Now what?
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI announced it's slowing down some of its AI development to focus on making the systems safer and more secure. This is surprising because the company usually moves very fast.
stories.why_it_matters: This is actually good news — it means OpenAI is taking safety seriously instead of rushing products to market too quickly.

stories.title: Meta AI is getting a Mac app
stories.simple_summary: Meta (Facebook's parent company) made a new app for Mac computers that lets their AI chatbot see what's on your screen and help you with it. You can also talk to it using voice.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use a Mac, you now have a free AI assistant available — useful if you want help answering questions or creating content.

stories.title: TerraPower’s nuclear reactor has a secret weapon for powering AI data centers
stories.simple_summary: TerraPower (a nuclear power company) is building nuclear reactors that are designed to power the huge data centers that run AI systems. Their technology has special advantages over competitors.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies — nothing you need to act on.
